name: Cardiff Metropolitan University

facts.text: Cardiff Met's main address is Llandaff Campus, Western Avenue, Cardiff, CF5 2YB, and it also has a Cyncoed campus where halls such as Cyncoed Halls are located.
Cardiff Met has five academic schools: Art & Design; Education & Social Policy; Management; Sport & Health Sciences; and Technologies.

Cardiff Met describes itself as 'A leading modern university with a distinctive offer across a wide range of creative, sports, health, education, technology, social and life sciences, and business disciplines.'
The university draws on 'over 150 years of commitment to education as a force for good in the Cardiff Capital Region and beyond.'
Notable centres include the ZERO2FIVE Food Industry Centre and PDR, the International Centre for Design and Research.
